# Tesseract.js (bundled)

Bundled here so reading text from photos works without loading code from another website.

- tesseract.js 7.0.0 and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 — Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- English language data (4.0.0_best_int) from @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 — https://github.com/naptha/tessdata

To update: `npm install tesseract.js @tesseract.js-data/eng`, then copy the same files from node_modules.
